szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial Intelligence is rapidly transforming U.S. workplaces, yet a complex patchwork of state-specific AI laws across Illinois, Colorado, California, Connecticut, Minnesota...

There is no denying that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping the U.S. labor market and is here to stay. Being used in everything from recruitment to employee management, AI utilization is becoming mainstream at most workplaces. There is currently a growing patchwork of AI laws across states including Illinois, Colorado, California, Connecticut, Minnesota, New York City, Texas and Utah. Each AI law differs in scope, notice, enforcement and audit requirements, creating complexities for multi-state employers.
